copy.curiosityHook: When a hit-and-run cover-up triggers a terrifying biological shift, how far will the metal spread before the man completely disappears?
copy.description: After striking a tormented metal fetishist with their car and hiding the body, a Japanese businessman and his girlfriend try to move on, only for him to suffer a vicious curse that turns his flesh to iron.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and aggressively strange, demanding focused attention for a compact late-night solo watch.
copy.whyWatch: Shinya Tsukamoto's 67-minute cyberpunk horror delivers a ferocious, heavy collision of industrial nightmare and bodily mutation, built for viewers seeking uncompromising intensity.

excludedMaterial: Third-act events and final fate of Tokyo or the protagonist
